messages:
Kevin L: quick standup — did the AZ prewarm script tweak last night (reduced batch size to 16 for p3s), noticed slower kvcache fill in eu-west1. no customer impact yet but seeing more cold-starts.
Anya: ah ok, did you see the higher seq-len jobs causing cache churn? saw a few large-embed jobs around 02:00 UTC.
Kevin L: yea that matches. suspect long-context evals from the rerank job. thinking to pin smaller cache TTL for those jobs.
Sam: opened a quota ticket with cloud for extra p3 slots in eu-west1 (INC-8921) — signal that we might need short-term burst.
Maria: I can escalate with infra-sig if we need emergency capacity. FYI I started a GCP quota request (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/INC-8921) and asked for cross-AZ fallback enablement.
Anya: for prewarm, can we do a KV-cache-only warmup pass instead of full model preloads? saves vram and still reduces cold latency.
Kevin L: good idea, Anya. I'll prototype a warmup job that primes KV only — runs faster. psuedo command: `./tools/prewarm --mode=kv --region=eu-west1 --pool=prewarm-small`
deploy-bot: autoscaler: scaled up prewarm-small pool in eu-west1 by +3 instances at 2334567905 :rocket:
Sam: heads-up — if autoscaler keeps adding spot nodes, we should enable spot-fallback to on-demand for critical canaries. I'll add a flag in the deploy config.
Maria: blocker: need approval for burst budget for the weekend (finance). pinging @finance for $ approval. if denied, fallback plan is to shift noncritical rerank to us-central1.
Kevin L: blocker for me: need node image with kernel patch (from security) — Anya can you take image build? should be quick.
Anya: can do, queueing a build now. ETA ~45m. will post AMI when ready.
Kevin L: ok thanks — today I'll finish the KV-only warmup prototype and run a short canary against eu-west1, will report latency numbers.
Sam: i'll monitor queue depth and ramp down noncritical workloads if quota stays tight.
Maria: I'll follow up with finance and update the ticket. also will add a rollback window for the warmup experiment.
Kevin L: thanks team. if anything spikes, mention #incidents. end of thread.
